item.title: Little Rock Convention & Visitors Bureau releases 2025 report, highlights tourism growth
item.description: Tourism is going up in Little Rock, according to a report released by the Little Rock Convention & Visitors Bureau.

item.title: Arkansas prison system's 'Future Fit Program' sees first graduates
item.description: The first class of Arkansas' Future Fit Program has officially graduated, marking a significant step in the state's effort to reduce repeat incarceration while strengthening the workforce.

item.title: 'Grey's Anatomy' star Eric Dane dies after ALS battle
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.

item.title: AST Blog: Your City’s Rainfall So Far This Winter
item.description: Rainfall has been all over the place in Arkansas this winter. One city might have picked up a solid amount of rain, while another is still experiencing a huge deficit just a couple counties away.

item.title: Former Arkansas First Ladies fighting to keep PBS on Arkansas TV
item.description: A battle over the future of public television in Arkansas continues on as two former Arkansas first ladies are leading a new group trying to keep PBS on Arkansas airwaves with a deal with Arkansas TV set to expire in late June.

item.title: Arkansas schools, authorities developing new response strategies to stay a step ahead of possible future threats
item.description: Recent hoaxes at schools across the South have spurred Arkansas school and those that protect them to develop new strategies for responding to any threat, real or fake.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Blog: Critical wildfire danger on Thursday
item.description: Very warm and blustery conditions meet with incoming dry air and our ongoing drought to create an elevated risk of wildfire danger on Thursday, February 19.
